shop.name: Premier Auto Care
shop.description: A complete auto service center offering professional diagnostics, brake repair, engine tuning, AC servicing, electrical work, oil changes, and full vehicle inspections. Our experienced mechanics use modern diagnostic equipment to pinpoint issues fast and fix them right the first time. Transparent pricing, honest assessments, and quality workmanship — every car, every time.
shop.mission: To give every customer honest, reliable, and affordable vehicle service — using modern diagnostic equipment and quality parts, with no unnecessary repairs and no hidden charges.
shop.vision: To be Lahore's most recommended auto workshop, known for transparent pricing, dependable workmanship, and a service team that treats every car like its own.

hero.headline: Lahore's Trusted Full-Service Auto Workshop
hero.subheadline: Brake repair, engine diagnostics, AC service, electrical work, and more — all under one roof, done right the first time at a fair price.

services.name: Brake Repair
services.description: Pads, discs, drums, and full brake system overhauls. We replace worn components with quality parts and road-test every brake job so you stop safely, every time.

services.name: Engine Diagnostics
services.description: Computerised engine scanning to pin down warning lights, rough idling, and performance issues fast. We find the real problem — not just the symptom.

services.name: AC Service
services.description: AC recharge, leak detection, and compressor or condenser replacement. We make sure your air conditioning blows cold and stays reliable through Lahore's summer.

services.name: Electrical Work
services.description: Alternator, starter, wiring, and lighting repairs for all makes and models. From a dead battery to full electrical fault-finding, we've got you covered.

services.name: Oil Change
services.description: Quick, professional engine oil and filter changes using the right grade of oil for your car, keeping your engine protected between services.

services.name: Vehicle Inspection
services.description: Pre-purchase and pre-travel inspections covering brakes, suspension, fluids, tyres, and electronics — with a plain-language report on the car's real condition.

whyChooseUs.title: Experienced Mechanics
whyChooseUs.description: Certified technicians with over a decade of combined experience across Japanese, European, and Korean vehicles.

whyChooseUs.title: Modern Equipment
whyChooseUs.description: Computerised diagnostics, professional AC machines, and the right tools for every job — so repairs are done accurately the first time.

whyChooseUs.title: Transparent Pricing
whyChooseUs.description: You approve a written quote before any work starts. No surprise charges and no unnecessary repairs — just honest advice.

whyChooseUs.title: Genuine & Quality Parts
whyChooseUs.description: We fit original and trusted aftermarket parts sourced from authorised suppliers, and back major work with a warranty.

workProcess.title: Diagnose

workProcess.title: Plan

workProcess.title: Repair

workProcess.title: Deliver

faqs.question: How much does a car service cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on your vehicle and what it needs. An oil change with filter typically starts from Rs 4,000, while a full service is usually between Rs 8,000 and Rs 15,000. You always get a written quote before we start.

faqs.question: Do you provide pick-up and drop-off?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer pick-up and drop-off for customers in the Lahore Cantt and surrounding areas. Just call us and we'll arrange a convenient time.

faqs.question: Can you fix an issue that other workshops couldn't diagnose?
faqs.answer: Very often, yes. We use computerised diagnostic equipment and a systematic approach, so we find the root cause instead of replacing parts at random.

faqs.question: Do you use original parts?
faqs.answer: We use original manufacturer parts wherever possible, plus trusted high-quality aftermarket parts as alternatives. You choose the option that fits your budget.

faqs.question: How long does a typical repair take?
faqs.answer: Most jobs — oil changes, brake pads, and AC servicing — are completed the same day. Major engine or electrical work can take one to two days. We give you an accurate time when you book.

faqs.question: Are your prices fixed, or do they change after the work?
faqs.answer: The quote we give you is the price you pay. If we find additional work mid-job, we stop and confirm with you first — you approve any extra cost before we proceed.
